name: Rep Coach
tagline: A lift-logging training partner that reshapes the programme around how you feel
description: You report sets in chat and it keeps the log, builds the next block, and reshuffles around a crowded week or sore joints. Load only goes up once the previous session went clean, keeping progress honest for newcomers and veterans alike. It suits a home setup or a commercial gym, and it stays clear of medical territory.
author: BTC_Yogi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
